actions.reasoning: The inbox view (screenshot) has been captured, documenting the suspicious Netflix message and its phishing destination was already identified earlier. Next steps are to report the message as phishing in Gmail, delete it, and if you need to update Netflix billing, sign in directly at the official Netflix site and update payment information from your account settings. I finished here to avoid entering any personal/payment data into an untrusted page.
